claims.source_quote_ar: وَقَالَ الْكُوفِيُّونَ: الْأَصْلُ ذَبَبَ، فَأُبْدِلَ مِنَ الْبَاءِ الْأُولَى ذَالًا،
claims.claim_ar: قال الكوفيون: الأصل «ذَبَبَ» فأُبدِلَ من الباء الأولى ذالاً (قراءة/تقرير نصي يختلف عن القراءة المعهودة «تِلْكَ/ذَلِكَ»).
claims.claim_en: The Kufans say the original was 'ذَبَبَ' and the first bā' was replaced by a dhāl (a reported textual/reading variant compared with the familiar 'تِلْكَ/ذَلِكَ').
claims.needs_review_reason: This is a reported Kufī remark about the original wording/reading; requires verification against textual manuscripts and qirā'āt sources to confirm applicability to this verse.

claims.source_quote_ar: وَ «ذَلِكَ» فِي مَوْضِعٍ بَيْنَهُمَا؛ أَيْ: بَيْنَ الْإِيمَانِ وَالْكُفْرِ،
claims.claim_ar: «تِلْكَ/ذَلِكَ» في موضع بين الإيمان والكفر: أي تدل على قومٍ متذبذبين بين الإيمان والكفر (محلّهم بين طائفتين).
claims.claim_en: The demonstrative 'تِلْكَ/ذَلِكَ' is positioned 'between them' — i.e. between belief and disbelief — indicating people who are wavering between faith and disbelief.
claims.needs_review_reason: Interpretive semantic claim derived from the commentary; check whether the commentator intends this specifically for this verse's demonstrative (وتِلْكَ) and whether alternative readings/meanings are offered.
